lines.en: label chikaspecial40:
scene chikalunch1
Okay.
lines.zh: 好吧。

lines.en: I’m tired of winter.
lines.zh: 我受够冬天了。

lines.en: And I would very much like summer to come back now.
lines.zh: 我真希望夏天现在赶紧回来。

lines.en: I wonder if Maya knows any way to sort of just...push up the date of the next reset and usher in another change of seasons or something.
lines.zh: 不知道 Maya 有没有什么办法，能……把下次「重置」的日子提前，顺便换季什么的。

lines.en: The cold was nice at first- but even now, in the earliest stages of its death, I grow tired of its tomfoolery.
lines.zh: 冷一开始还挺舒服——可现在，哪怕它才刚开始消退，我也烦透了它这套鬼把戏。

lines.en: Desperate for a change of pace, I clutch my fists together and wait for Maya to conveniently appear before me.
lines.zh: 太想换个节奏了，我攥紧拳头，等 Maya 恰好出现在我面前。

lines.en: Everyone knows that once I think of something like that, it almost always immediately happens. And I see no purpose in a reversal of fortune this early on a Monday morning.
lines.zh: 谁都知道，只要我这么一想，事情几乎立刻就会发生。而且我可不想在大清早的周一就运气反转。

lines.en: : Any minute now.
lines.zh: : 随时都会来。

lines.en: scene chikalunch2
: Hey! Crazy seeing you here, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 嘿！在这儿碰见你真巧，Sensei。

lines.en: : Hey, Maya. You got exponentially taller, tanner, and less weird since I last saw you.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Maya。自打上次见你，你呈指数级地长高、变黑、也没那么怪了。

lines.en: scene chikalunch3
: Maya? Are you wandering around looking for her or something?
lines.zh: : Maya？你在到处找她吗？

lines.en: : It’s more like I’m...wandering around in search of summer. And Maya is the only person I know with time manipulation powers.
lines.zh: : 更像是……我在到处找「夏天」。而 Maya 是我认识的人里唯一会操纵时间的。

lines.en: : You know, I always thought there was something weird going on with her, but time manipulation was pretty low on my list.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我一直觉得她有点不对劲，但「操纵时间」在我的猜测清单里可排不上号。

lines.en: : Well, now that you know, I’m excited for you to either forget all about it or just think I’m joking.
lines.zh: : 好吧，既然你知道了，我就等着你要么全忘掉，要么当我开玩笑。

lines.en: scene chikalunch4
: Oh, come on. If superpowers like that were real, Chinami would be like, flying around and killing dragons or whatever it is wizards actually do.
lines.zh: : 哦，得了吧。要是那种超能力是真的，Chinami 早就满天飞、斩杀巨龙，或者干点巫师该干的事了。

lines.en: : Fantasy isn’t my favorite genre, so I'm not going to pretend to know much about it, but I’m pretty sure wizards don’t fly.
lines.zh: : 奇幻不是我的菜，所以我不装懂，但我很确定巫师不会飞。

lines.en: scene chikalunch5
: So, is this just what you’re doing for lunch? Walking around, fantasizing about Maya instead of your real girlfriend?
lines.zh: : 所以这就是你午饭的安排？到处晃，幻想 Maya，而不是你真正的女朋友？

lines.en: : This is actually one of the very rare occasions where I’m {i}not{/i} fantasizing about something that would make you mad at me.
lines.zh: : 这其实是极少数我{i}没{/i}在幻想「会惹你生气」的事的时候。

lines.en: scene chikalunch6
: Wait, what is that supposed to mean?! How often are you fantasizing about stuff like that?!
lines.zh: : 等等，那是什么意思？！你到底有多常幻想那种事？！

lines.en: : Sorry, did I say stuff that would make you mad at me? I meant...fantasizing about the two of us on some sort of romantic getaway or...some other cute thing.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我刚说「惹你生气」？我是说……幻想咱俩去什么浪漫的度假地，或者……别的什么可爱的事。

lines.en: scene chikalunch7
: Aww~ You’re so sweet. This is why I love you.
lines.zh: : 哇～你真甜。所以我才爱你。

lines.en: Every day I spend with Chika is one day closer to realizing that she lives in a world of blissful ignorance, where only the things she {i}wants{/i} to hear manage to stick to whatever part of the brain stores memories.
lines.zh: 跟 Chika 相处的每一天，都让我更确信一点：她活在一个幸福无知的世界里，只有她{i}想{/i}听的话，才进得了负责存记忆的那部分脑子。

lines.en: Which is great for me, don’t get me wrong. But being that far into dreamland might be a little dangerous, especially when it comes time for her to leave.
lines.zh: 这对我当然是好事，别误会。但沉在梦里沉得这么深，可能有点危险——尤其到了她该离开的时候。

lines.en: She...has to realize eventually, doesn’t she?
lines.zh: 她……迟早会明白的，对吧？

lines.en: That even on the days where I want this to be anything more than it is, there’s another side of me buried somewhere in the back of my head mocking me for even pretending it’s real.
lines.zh: 明白即使在那些「我希望这不止于此」的日子里，我心底某处也藏着另一个自己，嘲笑我居然假装这一切都是真的。

lines.en: I just don’t want to be the one to force her into realizing that it’s not...and that this {i}relationship{/i} was all built on one huge misunderstanding.
lines.zh: 我只是不想当那个逼她看清「这不是真的」的人——看清这段{i}关系{/i}整个建立在一个巨大的误会之上。

lines.en: A misunderstanding that is, of course, my fault. And I’m an idiot for thinking that even a teenager as mature as Chika would think like an adult 100%% of the time.
lines.zh: 而这误会当然是我的错。我也真是蠢，居然以为一个像 Chika 这样早熟的未成年，能时时刻刻都像成年人一样思考。

lines.en: But I really can’t just let this go on forever.
lines.zh: 可我真的不能就这么一直拖下去。

lines.en: : Wanna go have sex in your office?
lines.zh: : 想去你办公室做爱吗？

lines.en: A little longer wouldn’t hurt, though.
lines.zh: 再拖一会儿也无妨。

lines.en: : Yes.
scene chikalunch8
: Too bad. I’m hungry.
lines.zh: : 可惜了。我饿了。

lines.en: I hate girls.
lines.zh: 我讨厌女孩。

lines.en: scene chikalunch9
: Hey, wanna come with me to the cafeteria? We can eat lunch together and no one will think it’s weird because you’re a teacher.
lines.zh: : 嘿，跟我去食堂吗？我们可以一起吃午饭，没人会觉得奇怪，因为你是老师。

lines.en: : I think me doing things like this is exactly why there are so many rumors apparently spreading about me.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我干这种事，正是那些关于我的谣言满天飞的原因。

lines.en: : Yeah, but those are just rumors. Rumors are {i}always{/i} going to exist, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 是，可那只是谣言。谣言{i}总会{/i}有的，Sensei。

lines.en: : Like that one about you dating Niki Nakayama. Like, obviously that never actually happened, but people are still saying it.
lines.zh: : 就像那条「你在跟 Niki Nakayama 约会」的。显然那根本没发生过，可大家还在传。

lines.en: : That did actually happen, though.
lines.zh: : 那事是真的。

lines.en: : Hahah~! Sure it did, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 哈哈～！当然是真的咯，Sensei。

lines.en: : Before I offer to call her and prove you wrong, will you tell me why you don’t think it’s true? Am I not cool enough to date an idol?
lines.zh: : 在我提议打给她证明你错之前，你先说说为什么觉得不是真的？是我不够酷，配不上跟偶像约会？

lines.en: : I think you’re the coolest guy in the world. And one of the hottest, too.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你是全世界最酷的男人。而且也是最帅的之一。

lines.en: : One of?
lines.zh: : 之一？

lines.en: : Idols are on another level, though. Especially ones like Niki. They don’t date {i}anyone{/i} because they belong to all of us.
lines.zh: : 可偶像是另一个层面的。尤其是 Niki 那样的。他们不跟{i}任何人{/i}约会，因为他们属于我们大家。

lines.en: Boy, do I have bad news for her.
lines.zh: 那我可得给她个坏消息了。

lines.en: : This was before she became an idol, though.
lines.zh: : 不过那是在她当偶像之前。

lines.en: : Well, she wasn’t {i}Niki{/i} before she became an idol. She was just Niki.
lines.zh: : 可她当偶像之前还不是「{i}Niki{/i}」。她只是 Niki。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. My mistake. I didn’t realize she was possessed by the soul of music.
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。我的错。我不知道她被「音乐之魂」附体了。

lines.en: scene chikalunch10
: Well, I’m glad I got to be the one to educate {i}you{/i} for once.
lines.zh: : 好吧，真高兴这回轮到我给{i}你{/i}上一课。

lines.en: : When have I ever educated-
lines.zh: : 我什么时候给你上过——

lines.en: : Now, come with me to the cafeteria and eat lunch with me like the awesome, loving, loyal boyfriend you are.
lines.zh: : 现在，跟我去食堂，陪我吃午饭，像个又棒又贴心又忠诚的男朋友那样。

lines.en: : You know, I’m not really feeling that hungry today.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我今天其实不太饿。

lines.en: scene chikalunch2
: Well, I am. So that sucks for you.
lines.zh: : 可我饿。那你就倒霉了。

lines.en: : I’m sorry?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : Because you’re coming with me whether you like it or not.
lines.zh: : 因为不管你愿不愿意，你都得跟我去。

lines.en: : I don’t think this is how relationships are supposed to work.
lines.zh: : 我觉得谈恋爱不该是这个样子。

lines.en: : It’s exactly how they’re supposed to work. Besides, it’s not like anybody is going to come up to us and tell us to like, not eat together or something.
lines.zh: : 恰恰就该是这个样子。再说，又不会有人走过来说「你们不许一起吃饭」之类的话。

lines.en: : We’re not doing anything wrong. We’re just...making the most of our lunch period since we’re not {i}always{/i} able to spend time together, you know?
lines.zh: : 我们又没做什么错事。我们只是……充分利用午餐时间，反正我们又不是{i}总能{/i}待在一起，你懂吧？

lines.en: I...guess this could be a good time to talk to her about this whole “dating” thing?
lines.zh: 我……想这倒是个跟她谈谈「约会」这整件事的好时机？

lines.en: Especially now that she’s trying to act like we’re dating {i}in{/i}[school], which is exactly what I wanted to avoid at all costs.
lines.zh: 尤其现在她还想装成我们在学校{i}里{/i}约会——这正是我不惜一切代价想避免的。

lines.en: And something I thought she’d care a little more about avoiding too, but...it is what it is.
lines.zh: 而且我本以为她也会更上心地避免，可……事已至此。

lines.en: : Fine.
lines.zh: : 好吧。

lines.en: : But I’m not paying for your food since I’m already paying for your phone bill.
lines.zh: : 不过我不替你付饭钱，反正我已经在替你交话费了。

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. I can buy my own food. I’m a big girl.
lines.zh: : 行行。我自己买得起。我是大姑娘了。

lines.en: scene black
Chika tries to grab my hand to lead me down the hall, but I am able to dodge her grasp and inform her that holding hands is a little too much.
lines.zh: Chika 想抓我的手带我走，但我躲开了，告诉她牵手有点过头。

lines.en: And by a little, I mean a lot.
lines.zh: 我说的「有点」，其实是「很」。

lines.en: It’s not like we’re in the lobby of a hotel or a private onsen or anything like that. There are people here.
lines.zh: 我们又不是在酒店大堂或私人温泉之类的地方。这儿有别人。

lines.en: There are times when it’s okay to be clingy and times when it’s not.
lines.zh: 什么时候能黏人、什么时候不能，是有讲究的。

lines.en: And while the two of us are fully clothed and out in the open, I’d say the current status of acceptability is far closer to {i}not.{/i}
lines.zh: 而现在我俩衣冠楚楚、大庭广众之下，「可接受度」显然更接近「{i}不能{/i}」。

lines.en: scene chikalunch11
So, the good thing is that the cafeteria is mostly empty today.
lines.zh: 好消息是，今天食堂里基本没人。

lines.en: The bad thing is that a few of the people who {i}are{/i} here are people that I know.
lines.zh: 坏消息是，{i}在{/i}场的那几个人，偏偏都是认识的。

lines.en: No one “dangerous” like Ami or Noriko or...anyone else who would get mad at me for sitting with a girl who isn’t them.
lines.zh: 倒没有 Ami、Noriko 那种「危险」的……也没有别的会因为「我跟别的女孩坐在一起」而冲我发火的人。

lines.en: But there's Yasu, Touka, that one new teacher, and Io- all the way back in the corner of the room, doing her best to assume the role of a socially anxious wallflower.
lines.zh: 但有 Yasu、Touka、那个新来的老师，还有 Io——缩在房间最角落，拼命扮演一个社交恐惧的壁花。

lines.en: And, even though I can’t see her from where I’m sitting, I’m sure she’s thinking something along the lines of, “Oh, good. They’re still {i}together,{/i}” while, unbeknownst to everyone but me, we’re not.
lines.zh: 而且，虽然从我坐的位置看不见她，我敢肯定她正想着「哦，真好，他们还{i}在一起{/i}」——可除了我没人知道，我们其实「没有」在一起。

lines.en: : You sure you’re not hungry? Because I probably won’t finish all of this and you can have whatever’s left of it.
lines.zh: : 你真不饿？因为我多半吃不完，剩下的都给你。

lines.en: : I’m okay. Ami made a big breakfast this morning.
lines.zh: : 我没事。今早 Ami 做了顿丰盛的早餐。

lines.en: : But, Ami makes a big breakfast pretty much every morning, so that’s nothing to really write home about.
lines.zh: : 可 Ami 几乎天天早上都做丰盛的早餐，所以这也没什么好稀奇的。

lines.en: scene chikalunch12
: Yeah...that’s actually super impressive. Like, doesn’t she leave the dorms really early every morning just so she can go home and cook for you? That’s some serious dedication.
lines.zh: : 是……这其实超厉害的。她是不是每天都特意老早离开宿舍，就为了回家给你做饭？这也太上心了。

lines.en: : Yeah, but I let her live in my house for free, so there’s that too.
lines.zh: : 是，可我让她白住我家，所以这算扯平。

lines.en: : Aren’t you also her legal guardian?
lines.zh: : 你不还是她的法定监护人吗？

lines.en: : I prefer the term “uncle.”
lines.zh: : 我更喜欢「叔叔」这个称呼。

lines.en: : Okay, but aren’t you like, {i}legally{/i} her legal guardian?
lines.zh: : 好吧，可{i}法律上{/i}你不就是她的法定监护人吗？

lines.en: : You’re sure talking a lot for someone who was very hungry just a moment ago.
lines.zh: : 你刚才不还饿得不行吗，怎么话这么多。

lines.en: scene chikalunch13
: All I’m saying is that she...really goes out of her way for you.
lines.zh: : 我只是想说，她……真的特别为你费心。

lines.en: : It kinda makes me a little jealous.
lines.zh: : 这让我有点嫉妒。

lines.en: : Like...{i}I{/i} want to cook breakfast for you and like, help out around your house and stuff.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}也想……给你做早餐，帮你打理家里什么的。

lines.en: : One key difference between you and Ami is that Ami doesn’t have to also take care of a kid. Just me.
lines.zh: : 你跟 Ami 的一个关键区别是：Ami 不用同时照顾一个孩子。只用照顾我。

lines.en: : Though, I guess there {i}is{/i} Ayane sometimes, and she can be a bit of a handful.
lines.zh: : 不过，偶尔也{i}会有{/i}个 Ayane，她有时候挺难搞的。

lines.en: scene chikalunch14
: Your house sounds really...lively.
lines.zh: : 你家听起来真……热闹。

lines.en: : Sometimes, yeah. Most of the time, it’s just me and her, though.
lines.zh: : 有时候是。不过大多数时候，就只有我和她。

lines.en: : I really hate to ask like this...but...
lines.zh: : 我真不想这么问……但是……

lines.en: : When I’m like, out of [high_school] and stuff...
lines.zh: : 等我……从[高中]毕业什么的之后……

lines.en: : Do you think there’s any chance that maybe Chinami and I could move in with you?
lines.zh: : 你觉得有没有可能，让 Chinami 和我搬去跟你住？

lines.en: : Like, you won’t have to hide how we’re seeing each other anymore once I’m not a student, and it would definitely help me out since I wouldn’t have to worry about rent anymore.
lines.zh: : 那样你就不用再瞒着我们交往的事了——反正我也不再是学生——而且对我肯定也有帮助，因为我就不用愁房租了。

lines.en: : What about Yumi? Where will she go?
lines.zh: : 那 Yumi 呢？她去哪儿？

lines.en: scene chikalunch15
: I don’t know. I’m sure she doesn’t expect me to take care of her forever, though. Like...she’s going to {i}have{/i} to find something to do on her own.
lines.zh: : 不知道。不过我肯定她也没指望我照顾她一辈子。她……{i}总得{/i}有自己要做的事。

lines.en: : And it’s not like I’m going to ask you if she can just come live with us as well when you haven’t even agreed to my sister and me coming yet.
lines.zh: : 而且我又不会在她都还没同意我妹妹和我搬进来之前，就得寸进尺地问「她能不能也一起来」。

lines.en: : I’d...have to run it by Ami.
lines.zh: : 我……得先问过 Ami。

lines.en: : Is Ami not leaving for college once she’s out of high school? Is all of that stuff she says about just devoting her entire life to you really true?
lines.zh: : Ami 高中毕业后不是要去上大学吗？她说的那些「一辈子都奉献给你」的话，该不会是真的吧？

lines.en: : Or do you think maybe she’s just saying that for now and...she’ll change her mind once it’s time to start like, growing up?
lines.zh: : 还是说，你觉得她只是现在这么说说……等到了该「长大」的时候，就会改变主意？

lines.en: : I think that you probably shouldn’t think too much about things that will be happening three years from now when we don’t even know what’s going to happen tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，你连明天会发生什么都不知道，就别去多想三年后才会发生的事了。

lines.en: scene chikalunch16
: Yeah? Are you gonna run off with my favorite idol and forget all about me?
lines.zh: : 是吗？那你会跟我最爱的偶像私奔、把我忘得一干二净吗？

lines.en: : Cause I wouldn’t really blame you. There’s no way I could compete with her.
lines.zh: : 因为我真不怪你。我根本没法跟她比。

lines.en: : At the risk of shattering your borderline inhuman expectations of Niki, I’m going to tell you now that she’s probably...not what you think she is.
lines.zh: : 冒着打破你对 Niki 那近乎非人的幻想的风险，我现在就告诉你：她大概……不是你想的那样。

lines.en: : Yeah, because I’m sure you know her {i}so{/i}, so well.
lines.zh: : 哦，就因为你{i}特别{/i}、特别了解她咯。

lines.en: : Well, considering that {i}she is my ex-girlfriend{/i} I think it’s safe to say I know her at least a {i}little{/i} well.
lines.zh: : 嗯，考虑到{i}她是我前女友{/i}，我觉得我至少{i}还算{/i}了解她。

lines.en: Just...only the tsundere parts. Not the ones Niki so desperately wants me to remember.
lines.zh: 只是……只有「傲娇」那部分。Niki 那么拼命想让我想起的那些，倒没有。

lines.en: scene chikalunch17
: Sensei, I’m not going to believe that! Are you and Noriko working together to spread this rumor or something?
lines.zh: : Sensei，我才不信！你是不是跟 Noriko 串通好了散布这个谣言？

lines.en: : Because if I believe this one, I’ll have to start believing the ones about how you’re secretly seeing like half of our class. Or how you and Maya-
lines.zh: : 因为这条我要是信了，那我就得连「你暗地里跟我们班一半人交往」、还有你跟 Maya——那些都信了。

lines.en: scene chikalunch18
: Wait, weren’t you looking for Maya when I bumped into you in the hall?
lines.zh: : 等等，我在走廊撞见你时，你不正在找 Maya 吗？

lines.en: : Nope. But back to the topic of Niki, we really did date in high school.
lines.zh: : 没有。不过说回 Niki，我们高中时真的交往过。

lines.en: scene chikalunch19
: Yeah, okay. I mean, I obviously don’t have a problem with it, but aren’t you in your thirties? How would you have dated Niki in high school if she’s like, ten years younger than you?
lines.zh: : 好吧。我是说，我当然没意见，可你不是三十多岁吗？Niki 比你小十岁，你们怎么可能在高中时交往？

lines.en: : Chika, just out of curiosity, how old do you think Niki is?
lines.zh: : Chika，我随口一问，你觉得 Niki 多大？

lines.en: scene chikalunch20
: She’s 22 and her birthday is March 3rd. Her favorite color is pink (Shocker, I know) and if she could live anywhere in the world, it would be Hawaii.
lines.zh: : 她 22 岁，生日 3 月 3 号。她最喜欢的颜色是粉色（惊不惊喜），要是能住在世界任何地方，她选夏威夷。

lines.en: : And where did you get that information?
lines.zh: : 你从哪儿弄来的这些信息？

lines.en: : Fan books...online...interviews. The info is all over the place, Sensei. At least do your research before trying to make me think you dated my role model.
lines.zh: : 粉丝手册……网上……采访。这些资料到处都是，Sensei。想让我相信你跟我偶像约会过，好歹先做点功课。

lines.en: Well, if nothing else, Niki was certainly right about the idol industry being ruthless and cutthroat.
lines.zh: 好吧，别的先不说，Niki 说偶像圈「残酷又血腥」，确实没说错。

lines.en: I’ll have to add this newfound revelation to the exposé I’m writing.
lines.zh: 我得把这个新发现，加进我正在写的那篇「揭秘」里。

lines.en: : Chika, Niki is 29 years old. Only a couple years younger than me.
lines.zh: : Chika，Niki 今年 29 岁。只比我小几岁。

lines.en: scene chikalunch21
: Oh, please. She’s 29 and she still looks like {i}that?{/i} Funny joke, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 得了吧。她 29 了还长{i}那样{/i}？笑话真好笑，Sensei。

lines.en: scene chikalunch22
: Besides, if I ever found out that my lips have been on the same penis as Niki's, I’d probably bite it off out of excitement.
lines.zh: : 再说，要是哪天我发现我的嘴唇碰过的鸡巴跟 Niki 碰过的是同一根，我说不定会激动得把它咬下来。

lines.en: scene chikalunch23
: Sensei, come on! I’m obviously joking!
lines.zh: : Sensei，拜托！我明显是开玩笑的！

lines.en: : Chika, there are certain things in life that you really just shouldn’t joke about...and biting someone’s penis off is one of them.
lines.zh: : Chika，有些事在生活里是真的不该拿来开玩笑……「咬掉别人的阴茎」就是其中之一。

lines.en: : Don’t worry. I like your penis too much to bite it off.
lines.zh: : 放心。我太喜欢你的阴茎了，舍不得咬。

lines.en: : I am very relieved to hear that. Now, if only you’d stop acting like that during the day at school.
lines.zh: : 听你这么说我就放心了。那么，只要你白天在学校别再做那种举动就好。

lines.en: scene chikalunch24
: What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: : Just that {i}this{/i} was supposed to be a little more secretive than eating lunch together and trying to hold my hand in the hallway.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我们{i}本该更隐秘{/i}一点，而不是一起吃午饭、还在走廊里想牵我的手。

lines.en: : Well, gee. Sorry for being in love with you. I don’t really see what the big deal is.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。对不起我这么爱你。我真看不出有什么大不了的。

lines.en: : The “big deal” is that you could get me in trouble.
lines.zh: : 「大不了」的是，你会给我惹麻烦。

lines.en: : You could get {i}both{/i} of us in trouble.
lines.zh: : 你会给我们{i}俩{/i}都惹麻烦。

lines.en: : And if you’re not going to respect that-
lines.zh: : 要是你不肯尊重这一点——

lines.en: scene chikalunch25
: Wait....Are you breaking up with me?...
lines.zh: : 等等……你是要跟我分手吗？……

lines.en: : Woah, hold on a second.
lines.zh: : 喂，等一下。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : What did I do wrong?
lines.zh: : 我做错什么了？

lines.en: : Is this because I asked to move in with you after [high_school]?
lines.zh: : 是因为我说想[高中]毕业后搬去跟你住吗？

lines.en: scene chikalunch26
: You can say no! I didn’t mean to move so fast!
lines.zh: : 你可以拒绝的！我不是想进展那么快！

lines.en: : Oh god, no. I really wasn't trying to-
lines.zh: : 哦天，不是。我真不是那个意思——

lines.en: : Chika, calm down.
lines.zh: : Chika，冷静点。

lines.en: scene chikalunch27
: I'm sorry.
lines.zh: : 对不起。

lines.en: : I just thought that you were about to give me like...an ultimatum or whatever...
lines.zh: : 我只是以为你要给我下……最后通牒什么的……

lines.en: : Then it clicked that I just asked about moving and...
lines.zh: : 然后我才反应过来，我刚提了搬进来的事，于是……

lines.en: : Are we okay?...
lines.zh: : 我们……还好吧？……

lines.en: : We won’t be if you don’t stop crying.
lines.zh: : 你再哭就不好了。

lines.en: : People are going to start thinking something is going on which, need I remind you, is exactly what I’m trying to avoid.
lines.zh: : 别人会开始以为我们之间有什么——需要我提醒吗，这正是我想避免的。

lines.en: : But we can forget about that for now...
lines.zh: : 不过这事我们先放一边……

lines.en: : You still haven’t eaten. Your food is going to get cold.
lines.zh: : 你还没吃呢。饭要凉了。

lines.en: scene chikalunch28
: Yeah.
: I’m...suddenly not very hungry anymore...
lines.zh: : 我……突然不太饿了……

lines.en: scene black
The rest of the lunch period goes by in mostly silence as I realize how foolish I was for even {i}thinking{/i} that now would be a good time to tell Chika to tone it down.
lines.zh: 午餐剩下的时间基本在沉默中度过，我意识到自己有多蠢——居然{i}以为{/i}现在是让 Chika「收敛点」的好时机。

lines.en: And, at this point, I’ll be lucky if {i}any{/i} time winds up being a good time to tell her that.
lines.zh: 而且到这地步，哪还有{i}什么{/i}时候会是好时机，我都要烧高香了。

lines.en: The worst part is that I want to blame {i}her{/i} for all of it.
lines.zh: 最糟的是，我想把这一切怪到{i}她{/i}头上。

lines.en: I want to blame her for misunderstanding what I wanted out of our time together...and painting me into a portrait of the family she’s always wanted.
lines.zh: 我想怪她误解了我对这段关系的期望……怪我把我画进了她一直想要的那幅「全家福」里。

lines.en: I’m the one who handed her the brush, though. And blaming her for using it just makes me question why I ever gave it to her in the first place.
lines.zh: 可画笔是我递给她的。怪她用了它，只会让我反问自己：当初干嘛要把画笔给她。

lines.en: She loves that portrait so much, though. So how am I supposed to tell her I hate it?
lines.zh: 可她是那么爱那幅画。我又怎么忍心告诉她我讨厌它？

lines.en: It doesn’t matter now, I guess.
lines.zh: 算了，现在想这些也没用了。

lines.en: I’ll just keep putting it off.
lines.zh: 我会继续往后拖。

lines.en: The same way I've been doing from the start.
lines.zh: 就像我从一开始就在做的那样。

lines.en: But, hey. At least on the bright side-
lines.zh: 不过，往好处想——

lines.en: I’m one day closer to summer.
lines.zh: 我离夏天又近了一天。
